issue_context.title: Remove HTTP/2 pseudo headers from request primary headers
issue_context.body:
Kestrel now optimizes how it processes request static indexes - https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/24730

HTTP/2 pseudo headers will usually be sent as static indexes so there is no need to have them in the "primary headers" which are checked for first.
comments: For context, you didn't do this in your PR because the KnownHeaders generated code kept breaking, right?
Yes. We'll see whether it still happens if it is the only change to KnownHeaders...

review_comments: Looks like this `if` and the `else` got switched and is causing the problem somehow?
Shouldn't we just remove the HTTP/2-only headers from AppendSwitchSection entirely since it's handled by TryHPackAppend?
It is still needed. A client doesn't have to use HPack. They could send header with ":authority" as name bytes.
